components.name: Navigation pill
components.description: Floating bottom glass navigation with a live-state dot and a sliding active pill.
components.html: WORKEXPERIENCEABOUTCONTACT
components.css: .ds-nav{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;padding:6px;border-radius:9999px;background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04);backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(150%);border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.09),inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25),0 20px 60px -20px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.75)}.ds-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--color-accent,#8fd3e4);margin:0 8px 0 12px}.ds-nav-item{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--color-muted,#9aa1aa);text-decoration:none;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:9999px;transition:color 200ms ease,transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-nav-item:hover{color:var(--color-text,#e8eaed)}.ds-nav-item:active{transform:scale(0.97)}.ds-nav-item.is-active{color:var(--color-text,#e8eaed);background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08)}.ds-nav-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent,#8fd3e4);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: A dark room, one instrument lit. Near-black ground, off-white type, one cold accent marking live state. The name fills the first viewport alone; everything else arrives on scroll. Glass is a material used on three floating things only; sections are separated by hairlines and space, never cards.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, used only for live state and motion
Hairlines and negative space instead of cards
Real system diagrams as the engineering signature

rules.name: The Live State Rule
rules.body: Ice marks something currently true or currently moving; static elements never get the accent.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace sets numbers, identifiers, dates and stack names, never headings or sentences.

rules.name: The Three Glass Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Glass is used on the nav pill, metadata chips and image frames. Nothing else.

dos: Do start every surface from Ink with off-white type and let scale carry hierarchy.
Do keep the accent to live state.
Do separate content with hairlines and 112 to 160px of space.
Do honor reduced motion and reduced transparency.
donts: Don't add cards, glows, gradient text, or a second accent.
Don't put an eyebrow label above a heading.
Don't use monospace for prose or headings.
Don't add terminal, matrix, cyberpunk or AI brain imagery, skill bars, testimonials, or a biography.
